title: Intermediate runtime values are not observable
expected_semantics: A semantic operation should expose typed input/output values or a stable value-observation handle so a debugger can explain how a state/value changed.
actual_behavior_limitation: execution-result/0.1 exposes returned values and operation identities but no intermediate values, writes, or value versions; debug traces can retain only static dataflow and return observations.
why_capability_matters: Without runtime value versions, 'why is x 17?' and watch/change semantics cannot be answered without guessing or rerunning altered programs.
current_workaround: Preserve request arguments, returned values, static inputs/outputs, and exact operation identity; label provenance partial and do not synthesize intermediate values.

host_language_code_required.classification: temporary adapter caused by an identified MNCS pressure
host_language_code_required.why: Host code normalizes available return/static evidence because no native inspection API exists.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Add bounded typed value-observation events with stable value identity, producer operation, read/write kind, and capture policy. Make emission explicit and disable-able.
alternatives_considered: infer values from source and request
snapshot every value in the launcher
resolution_criteria: A native execution fixture emits bounded typed intermediate value observations with producer/read/write identity, and mncs-debug can answer a value-origin query without heuristics.
